name: frontend-app
description: Customer-facing React + Vite SPA. Edge deploys to Cloudflare.
config_yml:
name: ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run build

name: api-gateway
description: Edge API gateway (Node + Fastify). Auth, rate-limit, multi-region.
config_yml:
stages:
  - lint
  - test
  - integration
  - deploy

lint:
  script: npm run lint
test:
  script: npm test -- --coverage
integration:
  script: npm run test:integration
deploy:
  script: ./deploy.sh
  only: [main]

name: infra-terraform
description: All cloud infra (GKE, RDS, S3) modeled in Terraform modules.
config_yml:
include:
  - template: terraform/Base.gitlab-ci.yml

stages:
  - validate
  - plan
  - apply

validate:
  extends: .terraform:validate
plan:
  extends: .terraform:plan
apply:
  extends: .terraform:apply
  when: manual
  only: [main]

name: mobile-ios
description: Native iOS app (Swift). TestFlight + AppStore deploys.
config_yml:
name: iOS
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: bundle install
      - run: bundle exec fastlane test
      - run: bundle exec fastlane beta
